from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AssetBalance(BaseModel):
    """Asset balance at a specific point in time from a 10-Q filing."""
    balance_date: str | None = Field(description="The date of the balance sheet (e.g., 'March 31, 2024' or 'December 31, 2023')")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Assets value as reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., 'thousand', 'dollars')")

class CompanyFilingInfo(BaseModel):
    """Financial information extracted from one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant name as identified in the filing")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by the filing (e.g., 'For the period ended March 31, 2024')")
    assets_current_period: list[AssetBalance] = Field(description="Asset balances reported at current period end date")
    assets_previous_period: list[AssetBalance] = Field(description="Asset balances reported at prior period end date")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the filing showing the total assets figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_filings: list[CompanyFilingInfo]
